title: Battle Flow
description: All-in-one combat automation for dnd5e (2024 rules). A hit rolls its damage and applies it through the system's own resistance math, with a per-target receipt and one-click revert on every card. A reaction that could change the outcome pauses the chain and asks the player, with the rule from the book and a timer. Saves, concentration, auras, cover, feats, fighting styles, masteries, maneuvers and metamagic are all in. Zero dependencies, no sockets, no patching: clients coordinate by reading the same chat log.
